candidate_program.name: bounded_density_discount
candidate_program.rationale: Modestly softens count pressure when the root blocks a large fraction of the active set, retaining a positive denominator throughout. Reach combines local degree and residual size; arithmetic is fixed, but active count updates remain charged and density does not reveal neighbor connectivity.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + degree * (1 - 0.25 * min(1, degree / max(1, remaining_count - 1))))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
